## Comparative Haken reference

Hermann Haken's *Synergetics: Introduction and Advanced Topics* is a separate copyrighted Springer work. Only bibliographic facts and an original high-level comparison are included.

## Interface inspiration

The interaction design is an original homage to the general category of mid-1990s multimedia encyclopedias and desktop software. No Microsoft Encarta code, artwork, sounds, screenshots, database text, or branding assets are included.
